message: The 'hides the HR Tools tab ... no questionnaire' test waits only for the query to be requested, then flushes with one empty act. If the status response has not resolved by then, the not-contain assertion passes before any response is processed, so a regression that shows the tab for a missing questionnaire would not turn this test red.
dismissalDetail: with useNsoMpdQuestionnaireHidden forced to show the item, this exact test failed, so the act flush lets the status response land before the assertion

message: Layer 1 still says canSeeHrTools includes reportsDisabled, but useNavPages.tsx only checks UsStaff, HybridStaff and developerBypass. The f13 fix in this range added a sentence but left the stale phrase, so the doc now contradicts itself.

The questionnaire-only test waits for the final state, so it does not catch gated tools showing while UserOption is still loading or after it fails. useReportsDisabled reports false until UserOption data arrives.
dismissalDetail: that test and useReportsDisabled are unchanged in this pass, and the end state is what the menu shows

message: 'the user group prompt' is not defined anywhere in the doc and sits right above the 'Layer 2: US staff group' bullet, so readers may think the questionnaire skips the Layer 2 group gate.
The doc records the questionnaire's inline flag reads as a special case instead of splitting useReportsDisabled into a flag part and a verified part, so kill switches can drift across hooks.
dismissalDetail: same design point as #10, already dismissed as intentional

message: The new sentence says the questionnaire checks only the two flags, but useNsoMpdQuestionnaireHidden also checks isUsStaffLike(userType) and falls back to the New Staff group on query error.
spouseUsStaffGroup is set in makeWrapper but no assertion in this file depends on it, adding mock noise.
dismissalDetail: makeWrapper models a New Staff household, so both spouses get the New Staff group

message: mockSession values set with mockReturnValue carry over to later tests because afterEach does not reset the session.
dismissalDetail: the mockSession calls and afterEach are unchanged in this pass, and every test sets its own session

message: The status-queried wait and the New Staff user fixture are copied from other hook tests, so changes to one copy will not reach the others.
dismissalDetail: a few test lines that mirror the pattern in useNsoMpdQuestionnaireHidden.test, not worth a shared helper

message: The new wait checks NewStaffQuestionnaireStatus was called but not with which accountListId, so a wrong variable would still pass.
dismissalDetail: the router is fixed to account-list-1 and useAccountListId cannot return a different id here
